children: High Tide's German medical cannabis subsidiary Remexian distributed a record 10.2 tons of product in fiscal third quarter 2026, up 62% from a year earlier. The segment generated record revenue of $38.2 million with gross margin of 26%. Since High Tide acquired its majority stake, Remexian's market share in Germany has climbed from 6.5% to 10.5% in six months. The company cites its Canadian supply relationships as a competitive advantage in the expanding German medical market.
